errors.text_span: секторите визуално изглеждат подредени приблизително по низходящ размер (син, оранжев, червен, зелен)
errors.evidence: The description claims that the sectors are visually arranged in descending order of size. However, the visual order clockwise from the top is Blue (value 40), Orange (25), Green (4), and Red (18). This is not descending order, as the Green sector (4) appears before the Red sector (18).
